sourceOfTruth.rule: Private VMesh is canonical. Public-safe discovery outputs may be ingested into private; private source truth is never pushed outward by default.

operatingRules: VMesh is an aggregator and indexer, not heavy data storage.
Terrain selection runs first; vectors, soils, landcover, ecology, climate, hazard, imagery, and parcel context cannot upgrade terrain truth.
Return source refs, coverage evidence, fetch recipes, confidence, rejected-source reasons, and gaps.
Downstream workers execute recipes and store or render payloads.
Synthetic, generic, visual, or modelled fallbacks must be explicitly labelled and confidence-capped.
Do not commit exact private coordinates, private addresses, local paths, secrets, signed URLs, paid-provider refs, or raw bulky payloads.
License-gated or research-only sources stay out of operational defaults until reviewed.

tracks.purpose: Make VMesh answer coordinate, H3, parcel-center, or AOI requests with the best open source land-intelligence package for USA, Canada, and the UK.
Prove VMesh can hand Abundance executable source recipes that become source packs and runtime-pack inputs without renderer coupling.

gates: public-safe route proofs for USA, Canada/BC, and UK

entries.deliverable: Terrain-first provider selection and proof matrix for USA 3DEP, BC LidarBC/HRDEM, Canada HRDEM, England, Scotland, and generic fallback regions.
gates: live/source-preview proof artifacts where providers are reachable

entries.deliverable: Coverage-aware jurisdiction and H3 routing index that explains which source families apply at a coordinate and which need probe/review.
Typed executable recipe families for STAC/COG, ArcGIS image export, ArcGIS feature query, GeoParquet bbox, download indexes, and manual-review gaps.
gates: unsafe URL and local path rejection tests

entries.deliverable: Buildings, roads, hydro/water, parcels, addresses, and other open vector source ladders with Overture/OSM/official-source provenance and gaps.
Source ladders and confidence caps for soils, landcover, vegetation/ecology, biodiversity/carbon, climate/weather, and risk/hazard context.
Canonical vmesh-abundance-source-handoff-v1 emission from the resolver with source recipes and explicit gaps for Abundance.
Live-proof matrix, privacy gates, capability assertions, and regression discipline for VMesh as an operational source broker.
Cross-repo audit of the VMesh, Abundance, and builder seam, including current gaps by data type.
Resolver mode that emits Abundance-compatible source handoffs.
Abundance-side executor adapter that consumes VMesh handoffs, queues site-package work, normalizes builder inputs, and emits fixture-safe source-pack summaries.
remaining: Live provider execution for each adapter family.
Public-safe matrix fixtures that run VMesh handoff to builder input to source pack to runtime bridge for every target region.
Actual site-runtime-pack.v1 generation from live payloads after terrain, vector, and mask payloads are present.

entries.deliverable: Public-safe terrain source-pack proof from VMesh handoff for USA, BC, Canada non-BC, England, Scotland, and generic fallback samples.
Source-backed buildings, roads, water, landcover, vegetation, and mask builder inputs and source-pack layers from VMesh recipes.
Honest capability-tier system explaining that anywhere is requestable, while quality depends on source coverage.
gates: downstream wording reviewed for no overclaim

entries.deliverable: End-to-end VMesh resolver to Abundance source-pack and runtime-pack input matrix across public-safe USA, BC, Canada non-BC, England, Scotland, and fallback samples.

landIntelligenceAggregator: For USA, Canada, and UK samples, VMesh can select terrain, vectors, hydro, soils, landcover, ecology, climate/weather, risk/hazard, imagery, and parcel/planning source candidates.
Each selected source includes role, coverage status, resolution or scale where known, confidence, license, attribution, limitations, rejected alternatives, and gaps.
VMesh emits executable recipes without storing heavy payloads by default.
Coverage gaps fail closed as needs_probe, blocked, license_gated, or source-ref-only.
abundanceSeam: VMesh emits vmesh-abundance-source-handoff-v1 for each public-safe matrix sample.
Abundance consumes the handoff and writes normalized builder inputs.
Abundance source-pack summaries are emitted with ready layers or explicit blocked gaps.
A runtime-pack readiness/input artifact exists for every sample without changing the frozen site-runtime-pack.v1 contract.
